entry.title: How to run SAC Pull integration Job from SAP Analytics Cloud Multi Action using API_FINPLANPULLJOB
entry.content:
Introduction

The purpose of this post is to introduce a new service API_FINPLANPULLJOB that was recently included into Communication Scenario SAP_COM_0087 of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. This service provides a convenient and tailored mechanism for planner to start integration jobs between SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP S/4HANA Cloud on the direction to S/4HANA by simple click directly from SAC Story using Multi Action.

It provides an alternative, but more direct way to start integration compared to manual start from S/4HANA Fiori application "Schedule Financial Plan Data Jobs". 

The new service is an alternative (so far only for Cloud customers) to the old approach of triggering integration jobs with generic service BC_EXT_APPJOB_MANAGEMENT as it was previously described in the Blog post.

The new service is supporting target types of ACDOCP, FINSSKF, ACCOSTRATE and CCFCTR.

To get the scenario working, some configuration steps are required: starting with configuring users on SAP S/4HANA side, followed by creating HTTP API connection on SAP Analytics Cloud side, and, finally, configuring Multi Action in SAC Story.

In this scenario it is important to understand that three types of S/4HANA users are involved in the process:
    - Communication user;
    - Business user for posting plan data ("posting" user);
    - Business user for monitoring application jobs and application logs ("monitoring" user).

A communication user is only used to call the needed S/4HANA inbound service (API_FINPLANPULLJOB) from SAC tenant, whereas the "posting" user is bearing all necessary authorizations for integrating data to respective target tables, for example, ACDOCP. Even though the whole process is triggered by SAC using the communication user, the actual integration Job gets started on behalf of "posting" user. After the job is finished, it collects application logs in the system. This log "belongs" to the communication user and by-default for security reasons is not available for reading by any other S/4HANA user. Therefore, we need a third type of user – a "monitoring user" which has extra authorization to see application logs of other S/4HANA users, i.e. to read logs created by communication user. The "posting" and "monitoring" can technically be the same S/4HANA user.

The following block-diagram provides a conceptual view on service architecture:

The following flow diagram describes an example of typical process, starting from pressing "Multi Action Starter" button in your Story, invoking all three types of endpoints, until a final message toast is displayed on the screen:

As a preparation to further configuration, you have to maintain these three users in the SAP S/4HANA client and grant each user the respective authorizations.

Prerequisite

Make sure that scope items 1YB and 1HB are active.

Settings for S/4HANA Public Cloud

1) Create communication user using App "Maintain Communication Users" (App ID F1338).

2) Create two communication systems for communication scenarios SAP_COM_0087 and SAP_COM_0326 and two communication arrangements respectively. The key requirement here is to specify the same communication user in the mentioned artifacts.

2.a) Use App "Communication Systems" (App ID F1762) to create two new systems for each communication scenario.

2.b) Use App "Communication Arrangements" (App ID F1763) to create two respective arrangements.

Note that a new service "Start Jobs to pull Plan Data from SAC" (API_FINPLANPULLJOB) has been included in the communication scenario SAP_COM_0087, that will be used in our integration task.

Note that a generic service "External Scheduler Integration" of comm. scenario SAP_COM_0326 (BC_EXT_APPJOB_MANAGEMENT) service will not be used in our integration task.

After the described configuration is done, your communication user must show up as used in the following communication artifacts:

Once communication arrangements get successfully activated, your communication user acquires all necessary authorizations to complete the desired task. The key authorizations are permission to run service API_FINPLANPULLJOB (inherited from communication scenario SAP_COM _0087) and permission to start application jobs on behalf of another user (inherited from communication scenario SAP_COM _0326).

3) Create a new business role using App “Maintain Business Roles” (App ID F1492). The minimal set of IAM Applications for performing our task include:

IAM App IDPurpose
SAC_INT_PULL_TRANFor running application "Manage Financial Plan Data Jobs for SAP Analytics Cloud Integration"
F7902_TRANFor running application "Schedule Financial Plan Data Jobs for SAP Analytics Cloud Integration"
F1240_TRAN and SP01_SIMPLE_TRAN To display the results of Application Jobs, i.e. application log which was created by another (communication) user

Click on "Maintain Restrictions". Maintain restrictions for restriction type "Activities on Other User’s Jobs" so that application logs for Job Catalog Entry SAP_FINS_INT_SAC_S4 can be viewed only. Specify App Job Part = JOB, SPOOL.

Click "Back" to get back to the main page of the role editor and save.

4) You need a "monitoring" user to view application jobs and application logs. If necessary, create a new business user for this purpose using App "Maintain Business Users" (App ID F1303). Alternatively, you might already have an existing business user in the system. In any of these cases, assign your newly created business role from p. 3 to your "monitoring" user.

5) Specify the "posting" user. You can do this by assigning such user to a Business User Group with pre-defined name ZCB_SAC_PULL using App "Maintain Business User Groups" (App ID F6399).
Note that the "posting" user for starting jobs can be the same as "monitoring" user from p. 4 or they can be different S/4HANA users.

Settings in SAP Analytics Cloud

1) Create a new connection of type HTTP API:

In the next dialog specify Data Service URL in the form:
https://<<s/4hana_tenant>>:443/sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_finplanpulljob/srvd_a2x/sap/finplansacpulljob/0001/FinPlanPullJob
Authentication Type = Basic Authentication
User Name = <<communication user name (alias)>>
Password = <<password for communication user>>

2) Go to Multi Actions -> create Multi Action:

Add API Step to your Multi Action:

In the properties of API Step:

  • select HTTP API Connection from p. 1:

  • Enter API URL in the form:

https://<<s/4hana_tenant>>/sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_finplanpulljob/srvd_a2x/sap/finplansacpulljob/0001/FinPlanPullJob/SAP__self.ScheduleJob

  • Set tick mark "Require CSRF Token" on.
  • Enter CSRF Token URL in the form:

https://<<s/4hana_tenant>>:443/sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_finplanpulljob/srvd_a2x/sap/finplansacpulljob/0001/FinPlanPullJob

  • Enter Body of API request. Note that some of the parameters are optional. Refer to two examples below:
Minimal formExtended form

{
    "PlanDataImportConfigurationID": "<<your_config_ID>>"
}

{
    "PlanDataImportConfigurationID": "<<your_config_ID>>",
    "PlanDataImportIsTestMode": true/false,
    "PlanDataImportJobDelay": <<number_of_seconds>>,
    "PlanDataImportNumberOfAttempts": <<number>>
}

If job delay parameter equals to 0 or omitted, the job starts immediately. However, if you are using SAC subscriptions in your configuration, and amount of changed data in your model is big enough, then calculation of delta may take some time on SAC side. If this is the case, your job, if started immediately, may issue a request to your SAC model too early (i.e. before delta is ready on SAC side) and the corresponding response may return an old state of delta (i.e. may not return some latest changes). With this parameter you can mitigate this problem by starting your job with some delay.
The “number of attempts” parameter is another way to mitigate the risk of long delta calculation. The service keeps sending requests to the SAC model repeatedly several times until the response returns any record. Once the request returns any data, the service stops making attempts.

  • Under Generic API settings -> Response, choose option "Get API trigger status from HTTP status code and response body".
  • Press "Configure fields mapping" to map the fields of the service API_FINPLANPULLJOB with the fields of the API step:

  • In the Fields Mapping popup, go through the three configuration steps:
    • For "1. Enter JSON", copy and paste the following template of response for our service:

{
"PlanDataImportJobIdentifier": "JobID",
"PlanDataImportJobMessageText": "In Process",
"PlanDataImportJobStatusText": "IN_PROCESS"
}

  • For "2. Map Fields", map three fields between response of our service and expected fields of API Step – Job ID, Status and Message:

PlanDataImportJobIdentifier = JobID
PlanDataImportStatusText = Status
PlanDataImportJobMessageText = Message

The result of the mapping must look like below:

  • For "3. Map Status Value", map three values of expected by API Step “Status” field and actual response value of our service:

  • Under Get API Execution Request, choose method “Asynchronous Return”.
  • Enter “Polling API URL” in the form:

https://<<s/4hana_tenant>>:443/sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_finplanpulljob/srvd_a2x/sap/finplansacpulljob/0001/FinPlanPullJob/SAP__self.GetJobStatus(PlanDataImportJobIdentifier='${jobId}')

  • Under Get API Execution Result -> Response, choose option "Get API execution result from HTTP status code and response body".
  • Press "Configure fields mapping" to map the fields of the service response with expected fields of the API step:

  • In the Fields Mapping popup, go through three configuration steps:
    • For “1. Enter JSON”, copy and paste the following template of response for our service:

{
"PlanDataImportJobMessageText": "Job Completed with 100 records",
"PlanDataImportJobStatusText": "DONE"
}

  • For "2. Map Fields", map two fields between the response of our service and expected fields of API Step – Status and Message:
    PlanDataImportJobStatusText = Status
    PlanDataImportJobMessageText = Message

The result of the mapping must look like below:

  • For "3. Map Status Value", map the three values of expected by API Step “Status” field and actual response value of our service:

Note: there is a documentation and tutorial for adding an API Step 

3) Incorporate your Multi Action into your SAC Story:

Open SAC Story and choose Insert -> Starters -> Multi Action Starter:

Specify Label, Description and select your Multi Action from p. 2:

4) Save your Story and switch to View mode.

Smoke test

1) Create your Configuration ID using App “Manage Financial Plan Data Jobs - for SAP Analytics Cloud Integration” (App ID SAC_INT_PULL). Here is an example of the configuration we used in this smoke test:

2) Optionally, check that integration works as expected if you trigger it directly from the App “Schedule Financial Plan Data Jobs for SAP Analytics Cloud Integration” (App ID F7902).

3) As far as our configuration has Delta mode, in this smoke test we are going to change a data slice which is given in the filter settings of your Configuration ID. After you've saved your configuration, a new subscription gets automatically created on SAC side, which is immediately starting to monitor all the changes in the defined data slice of your model.

Go to your SAC Story and make any change(s) in the cell(s) inside this data slice.

4) Once you’ve made your changes in your SAC Story, click on Publish Data and Press Multi Action Starter.

During execution of the integration job, you should see a pop-up message on the screen:

Once the job is finished, you may get different messages.
In case of successful integration:

In case of an error at integration, the error message gets propagated directly to the message toast:

An error can be also caused by wrong configuration in S/4HANA or by providing incorrect parameters in the Multi Action:

Note that all messages you get in the form of message toasts are also available in the Job Monitor view:

In addition to high-level messaging in the SAC Job monitor, the planner has also a possibility for more deep analysis of integration flow. It may be necessary, for instance, for analysis of issues/errors. Planner may use the "monitoring" user in S/4HANA to log-in to SAP Fiori Launchpad and read application logs:

Conclusion

With the described approach, the planner can benefit from two powerful features in the SAC Pull framework which complement each other: the so-called "Delta Mode" of integration and the functionality to trigger integration by clicking a "Multi Action Starter" button in SAC Story. The first feature significantly shortens integration times, whereas the second one brings easiness of starting integration. This scenario is particularly useful where a planner modifies model data frequently in SAC Story and, on the other hand, there is a requirement to replicate these changes into S/4HANA on request.

entry.title: Finance in SAP Cloud ERP 2608
entry.content:
Hello finance experts! I’m excited to walk you through the latest finance innovations introduced in our 2608 release.
 
This update is loaded with capabilities that add more intelligence, automation, and visibility to your finance operations. We’re continuing our mission to streamline core activities, elevate analytical depth, and enable quicker, data-driven decisions.
 
Want the short version of the top Finance highlights in 2608? Watch my quick video.
 
For a complete rundown of everything included in this release, take a look at the table of contents below.
 
Let’s jump into the highlights!
 
Video 1. Release Highlight Video for Finance in SAP Cloud ERP 2608

Table of Content

This update highlights significant innovations in the following areas:

Accounting & Financial Close

  • End-to-end cost settlement process (CLM)
  • Introduction of configurable depreciation profiles
  • SAP Fiori app for posting asset transfers
  • Central Task Model management
  • Journal Entry Agent

Financial Planning & Analysis​

  • Comprehensive analytical capabilities for material values in actual costing
  • AI-assisted error resolution for cost accounting

Treasury & Working Capital

  • Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent (Demo video) 
  • Payment Inquiry Handling Agent
  • Risk-based payment approvals 
  • Bank Statement Processing
  • Dynamic discounting
  • Enrichment of Bank Statement Items
  • Enhancements to Matching Algorithms
  • Editable email body in Create Correspondence app

Revenue Management 

  • Enabling Custom Fields for the Contract Account RAP Object
  • Managing Direct Debit Prenotifications in Contract Accounting
  • Display of General Ledger Items in Contract Accounting (Demo video)

Accounting & Financial Close

End-to-end cost settlement process (CLM)
The latest 2608 release of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition introduces a range of powerful capabilities, including the new End-to-end cost settlement process within the Finance capability area. While the provided reference document lists this as a key innovation, it does not contain a detailed description of its specific functionalities. However, based on standard SAP principles and the direction of financial innovations, we can explore what such a process entails and the value it delivers to your organization.

An end-to-end cost settlement process is a critical function for maintaining financial accuracy and transparency. In essence, it governs the complete lifecycle of how costs are collected and allocated throughout the organization. This process involves capturing costs from various sources such as internal orders, projects, or cost centers where expenses are initially incurred and systematically settling them to their final destination cost objects, like a fixed asset, a profitability segment, or another department. A robust, integrated process ensures that all expenditures are accounted for correctly, providing a true and fair view of costs for specific activities, products, or services.

The primary benefit of implementing a comprehensive cost settlement process is the significant improvement in financial control and operational efficiency. By automating the periodic allocation of costs, businesses can drastically reduce the manual effort required during period-end closing, which in turn minimizes the risk of human error and accelerates the closing cycle. This automation leads to greater transparency, as it provides a clear and auditable trail of how costs flow through the enterprise. Ultimately, this empowers management with more accurate and timely data for crucial activities such as profitability analysis, budget monitoring, and informed strategic decision-making.

Introduction of configurable depreciation profiles

In essence, this feature provides organizations with greater control and flexibility over how they calculate and manage the depreciation of their fixed assets. Instead of being limited to standard, predefined depreciation methods, finance professionals can now define and customize their own depreciation calculation rules directly within the system to meet specific business or regulatory needs.

The primary benefit of this new capability is the enhanced flexibility it offers for global and local compliance. Many businesses operate in jurisdictions with unique statutory requirements for asset valuation that may not be covered by standard depreciation keys. Configurable depreciation profiles empower users to create tailored calculation methods that precisely align with these local accounting principles, reducing the need for manual workarounds and complex spreadsheets outside the ERP system. Consequently, this leads to more accurate and compliant financial reporting, improves the efficiency of period-end closing activities, and ensures that asset values are reflected correctly on the balance sheet, thereby strengthening financial governance and transparency across the enterprise.

SAP Fiori app for posting asset transfers

As part of our commitment to enhancing core financial processes, SAP has introduced a new SAP Fiori app specifically for posting asset transfers. This application provides a modern, user-friendly interface dedicated to managing the movement of fixed assets within your organization. In simple terms, this tool is designed to streamline the process of executing various transfer scenarios, such as moving an asset from one company code to another or reclassifying an asset. By leveraging the intuitive SAP Fiori user experience, this app simplifies a critical function within asset accounting.

The introduction of this dedicated Fiori application delivers significant benefits to finance professionals. The primary advantage is a marked improvement in user efficiency and process transparency. The app offers a guided, intuitive workflow that reduces the manual effort and complexity traditionally associated with asset transfers. This simplification helps minimize the risk of data entry errors and accelerates tasks related to asset portfolio management. Consequently, organizations can achieve a more agile and controlled approach to asset accounting, ensuring that asset data remains accurate and compliant across the enterprise.

Central Task Model management

This new feature provides a unified and simplified approach to managing your financial closing tasks. Essentially, Central Task Model management allows users to create, edit, publish, and delete task models directly within the SAP Advanced Financial Closing interface. Previously, this process required switching to a separate communication system. Now, the entire lifecycle of task models, including the maintenance of task model types and job variants, is consolidated into a single, intuitive environment. Once a task model is published, it becomes immediately available for use in your task list templates, facilitating the swift creation and reuse of standardized closing activities.

The primary benefit of this centralized approach is a marked increase in operational efficiency for both IT and business users. By eliminating the need to navigate between different systems, we significantly reduce the manual effort and time required to manage closing tasks. This streamlined workflow allows for the faster creation and deployment of reusable task definitions, making your financial close process more agile and responsive. Furthermore, the feature introduces a dedicated change log, which offers complete transparency and auditability by tracking all modifications made to task models and their related objects. This enhances governance and control, ensuring your financial closing activities are both efficient and compliant.

Journal Entry Agent

The Journal Entry Agent is a powerful new tool designed to fundamentally automate and simplify the creation of journal entries within SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. In essence, it acts as an intelligent assistant that processes spreadsheet data to generate accurate and compliant financial postings. Users can initiate this process conversationally by submitting data files through our digital assistant, Joule. The agent then analyzes the spreadsheet's content, automatically maps the columns to the required journal entry fields, and produces structured proposals. These proposals are then made available for finance professionals to review, adjust if necessary, and post via the dedicated Manage Journal Entry Proposals application.

Image 01. Journal Entry Agent

The primary benefit of utilizing the Journal Entry Agent is a significant increase in operational efficiency and accuracy. By automating what is often a time-consuming and manual task, the agent drastically reduces the time spent on data entry, allowing your finance team to focus on more strategic, value-added activities. This automation also improves the accuracy of journal entries, minimizing the risk of errors. Furthermore, the feature enhances transparency, as each generated proposal is directly linked to its source file, ensuring a clear and auditable trail. Ultimately, these capabilities streamline the entire journal entry workflow, contributing to a faster and more efficient period-end closing process for your organization.

Financial Planning & Analysis

Comprehensive analytical capabilities for material values in actual costing

The recent 2608 release of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition introduces a significant advancement within the Finance portfolio: Comprehensive analytical capabilities for material values in actual costing. In simple terms, actual costing is a method used to determine the true cost of materials after a period has ended by incorporating variances, such as those from purchase prices or resource consumption. While this provides a highly accurate financial picture, analyzing the vast amount of resulting data can be complex. This new feature directly addresses that challenge by providing powerful, embedded tools to dissect and understand the detailed components of your material costs with greater ease and clarity.

Video 2.Comprehensive analytical capabilities for material values in actual costing

The primary benefit of this enhancement is the profound level of transparency it offers to financial controllers and cost accountants. By leveraging these new analytical capabilities, users can move beyond high-level summaries to perform deep-dive analyses into cost drivers and variances. This facilitates more accurate profitability analysis, empowers more informed make-or-buy decisions, and helps identify opportunities for cost optimization within the supply chain. Ultimately, this leads to a more streamlined and insightful period-end closing process, reducing manual effort and enabling your finance teams to become strategic partners to the business by providing actionable intelligence derived directly from your actual material values.

AI-assisted error resolution for cost accounting

As part of the recent 2608 release for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, we are excited to introduce a suite of intelligent capabilities. Among these is the new AI-assisted error resolution for cost accounting. This feature is designed to fundamentally simplify and accelerate how finance professionals handle discrepancies within their cost accounting processes. In essence, it leverages the power of artificial intelligence to proactively identify, analyze, and guide users in resolving errors that can occur during critical tasks like cost allocations, internal settlements, and other period-end closing activities. By intelligently diagnosing the root cause of an issue, the system can reduce the need for extensive manual investigation, empowering users to address problems more efficiently.

The primary benefit of this innovation is a significant increase in both speed and accuracy for the financial close process. Cost accountants can move away from time-consuming, manual error-hunting and instead focus on value-added analysis, guided by AI-powered suggestions. This not only accelerates the resolution of issues but also enhances the overall quality and reliability of financial data. By streamlining a traditionally complex and labor-intensive area, AI-assisted error resolution helps reduce the pressure of period-end closing, minimizes the risk of human error, and ensures that management reporting is based on more accurate and timely information. This new capability marks another step forward in our commitment to embedding intelligent automation directly into core financial processes.

Treasury & Working Capital

Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent

The Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent is an intelligent solution designed to optimize and accelerate your periodic clearing activities for both accounts payable and accounts receivable. This agent analyzes open items and generates balanced matching proposals by leveraging commonly used reference fields to intelligently pair invoices and payments. These proposals are then validated by the system before being presented to your AP/AR accountants for final review and posting, all within dedicated SAP Fiori applications.

Video 3. Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent

The primary benefit of this agent is a significant reduction in the manual effort traditionally associated with matching and clearing open items. By providing clear explanations for its matching logic and automating the proposal generation, the agent accelerates clearing cycles and minimizes the risk of human error. This enhances operational efficiency, allowing your finance professionals to manage a higher volume of transactions with greater accuracy and confidence, ultimately freeing up their time for more analytical tasks.

Payment Inquiry Handling Agent

We are excited to introduce the Payment Inquiry Handling Agent, an AI-powered assistant embedded within SAP S/4HANA Cloud and accessible via our digital assistant, SAP Joule. This agent serves as a single, conversational point of contact for resolving accounts payable payment inquiries. Your AP accountants can now use natural language to ask questions or upload files to identify invoices. The agent connects directly to live financial data to check payment eligibility, propose appropriate payment methods, and guide the user from inquiry to resolution.

This innovation drastically accelerates the resolution of urgent payment questions, reducing a process that could take hours down to mere minutes. By eliminating the need to manually navigate through various SAP transactions, the agent significantly reduces manual coordination and administrative overhead. It empowers your AP team to provide faster, more accurate responses to payment status queries, improving both internal efficiency and supplier relationships.

Risk-based payment approvals 

Balancing payment security with operational efficiency is a critical challenge for every organization. The new risk-based payment approvals feature addresses this by introducing an intelligent workflow that automatically assesses the risk level of self-initiated payments. Using configurable risk signals such as one-time accounts, deviating payment data compared to master records, and payment source tagging the system calculates a risk score and routes payments accordingly. Low-risk payments can be processed automatically, while high-risk transactions are routed for manual review.

The value of this feature is threefold. Firstly, it increases straight-through processing rates by automating approvals for safe, low-risk payments, which accelerates your payment cycles. Secondly, it strengthens your financial controls and reduces exposure to fraud or errors through systematic, automated risk assessment. Finally, it optimizes the allocation of your finance resources by focusing their valuable time and attention exclusively on the transactions that warrant manual scrutiny, creating a more efficient and secure payment environment.

Bank Statement Processing: Value Extraction for Unstructured Fields (Memo Line) 

This innovation addresses the long-standing challenge of manually interpreting valuable data, such as invoice numbers or customer details, embedded within unstructured text fields like the memo line. With this new capability, you can now systematically automate the retrieval of key information. Using the dedicated SAP Fiori app, **Manage Value Extraction Rules - For Bank Statements (F9297)**, you can define specific, pattern-based rules to scan the memo line and extract relevant data points automatically upon ingestion of the bank statement, structuring it for use before the formal reconciliation process even begins.

The primary benefit of this innovation is a substantial increase in the efficiency and automation of your bank statement processing, which directly reduces the manual effort and operational overhead associated with reconciliation. By instructing the system on precisely what to look for, the extracted information is seamlessly passed to subsequent steps to identify the correct customer or open item, dramatically accelerating the matching process. This automation frees your finance professionals from tedious, repetitive tasks, allowing them to focus on more strategic activities like resolving complex exceptions. Ultimately, this enhancement improves data quality by minimizing manual input errors, leading to a more reliable and streamlined financial close.

Dynamic discounting : Automated Credit Memo Archival

For organizations utilizing dynamic discounting, regulatory compliance and document management are paramount. This release introduces a crucial integration with SAP Taulia for automated credit memo PDF archival. In jurisdictions where a formal credit document is required to accompany a discount taken on an early payment, SAP Taulia generates a legally compliant, digitally signed credit memo PDF. This new feature ensures that this PDF is automatically archived in SAP S/4HANA Cloud and stored against the corresponding financial journal entry using SAP's Harmonized Document Management (HDM) framework.

This automation delivers significant benefits by ensuring regulatory compliance with document archival mandates, particularly across the EU and beyond. It completely eliminates the manual effort of retrieving PDFs from an external portal and reattaching them within the ERP system, saving time and preventing errors. As your dynamic discounting program grows, this fully automated solution scales effortlessly, with no additional per-transaction overhead. It ensures your financial records are complete, compliant, and easily auditable.

Enrichment of Bank Statement Items

In the complex landscape of financial operations, the new "Enrichment of Bank Statement Items" feature directly addresses the time-consuming and manual task of reconciling bank statements. This enhancement, part of the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 release, provides a powerful automation capability that intelligently identifies and assigns the correct business partner—be it a customer or a supplier—to each bank statement item during the import process. This enrichment paves the way for a more streamlined reconciliation by ensuring transactions are correctly linked to the corresponding accounts from the outset.

The primary benefit of this innovation is a substantial increase in automation, leading to a more efficient and accurate reconciliation process. By minimizing manual intervention, your finance team can accelerate the financial close and focus on value-added analysis rather than repetitive tasks. Moreover, this feature offers remarkable flexibility, empowering users to define their own custom rules for deriving business partner accounts. This adaptability ensures that the automation can be tailored to your specific business scenarios and banking formats, leading to a highly accurate and reliable reconciliation process

Enhancements to Matching Algorithms

In the realm of finance, reconciling bank statements is a critical task, and the new **Enhancements to Matching Algorithms** in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition are designed to significantly advance the automation of this process. Simply put, these enhancements make the system smarter and more flexible when matching incoming payments to open invoices. New capabilities, such as "period aggregation matching," allow the system to reconcile a single payment against a group of open items that span different financial periods. Furthermore, the system now supports general ledger (G/L) items in its allocation logic and includes a "unique match switch," which instructs the system to only perform an automatic clearing if it finds exactly one perfect match, preventing potential errors.

The primary benefit of these enhanced algorithms is a marked increase in both flexibility and automation coverage for your bank reconciliation process. By empowering the system to understand and process more complex payment structures, you can significantly reduce the number of items requiring manual review, leading to higher straight-through processing rates and freeing up your finance professionals for more strategic work. Moreover, these enhancements provide more controlled and precise clearing behavior, which builds greater trust in the automated system. The new "unique match switch," for example, minimizes the risk of incorrect postings by restricting automation to unambiguous cases. This level of control ensures that while you are increasing automation, you are also improving accuracy and strengthening internal financial controls, leading to a more efficient and reliable financial close.

Editable email body in Create Correspondence app

Effective communication is key to maintaining strong relationships with customers and suppliers. The `Create Correspondence` SAP Fiori app has been enhanced to provide greater flexibility in your outbound communications. Users can now fully edit and format the body of the email that accompanies a correspondence PDF. While the system pre-populates the email from a template, both the subject line and message text can be customized, with rich text formatting options including changes to font, color, size, and style.

This enhancement significantly improves the user experience by empowering your team to tailor messages to a specific business context. Instead of relying on rigid templates, users can add personal notes, clarify details, or highlight important information directly within the email before sending it. This flexibility reduces the need for follow-up emails or clarifications, minimizing repetitive work and ensuring that your communications are as clear and effective as possible.

Revenue Management 

Enabling Custom Fields for the Contract Account RAP Object

A core requirement for modern businesses is the ability to adapt enterprise software to unique operational needs. With the 2608 release, we are introducing advanced extensibility for the contract account business object. This feature allows for the addition of custom fields directly within the Manage Contract Accounts Fiori app, utilizing the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP). This enhancement caters to both key users, who can implement custom logic without deep technical expertise, and developers, who can address more complex scenarios using predefined extension points in ABAP development tools.

The primary benefit of this innovation is the enhanced adaptability it provides. Your organization can now tailor the contract account to capture specific data points crucial to your business processes, directly improving data relevance and utility. Furthermore, by providing configurable extension points for core nodes and events, this feature significantly reduces development effort and complexity. Most importantly, these extensions are designed to be stable and upgrade-compatible, ensuring that your customisations are preserved through future system updates, thereby protecting your investment and maintaining system integrity.

Managing Direct Debit Prenotifications in Contract Accounting

Efficiently managing payment processes is critical for maintaining healthy cash flow and customer relationships. The 2608 release introduces the new 'Manage Direct Debit Pre-Notifications' (F9361) Fiori app to streamline the handling of SEPA direct debit prenotifications. This application provides a centralized and consolidated view of all prenotifications, displaying their current status and associated details. It serves as a single source of truth for monitoring these critical payment communications.

The user benefit is a significant improvement in operational oversight and efficiency. By having a comprehensive overview of all existing prenotifications in one place, finance professionals can quickly analyze their status and identify potential issues before they escalate. The ability to filter results and drill down into detailed information for each prenotification enables faster issue resolution and reduces manual effort spent on tracking and reconciliation. This ultimately leads to a more transparent and smoothly executed direct debit process.

Display of General Ledger Items in Contract Accounting 

Timely and transparent access to financial data is fundamental for effective period-end closing and reconciliation. Addressing this need, we are introducing the 'Display G/L Line Items in Contract Accounting' (F9342) Fiori app. This new application offers a comprehensive and flexible overview of General Ledger (G/L) items that have been posted within Contract Accounting, specifically designed to support the analysis of posting data required for closing activities.

This feature delivers immense value by providing immediate insights into posting data, even before the formal transfer of a reconciliation key. This allows for proactive analysis and early identification of discrepancies. For the user, this translates into streamlined and accelerated reconciliation and period-end closing activities. The fast, flexible summarization of G/L line items provides a new level of transparency, empowering financial teams to conduct their analysis with greater speed and accuracy, thereby improving the overall quality and efficiency of the financial close.

entry.title: SAP Enterprise Service Management Q3 2026 Innovation Highlights
entry.content:
As SAP's Autonomous Enterprise vision continues to take shape across our portfolio, in Q3 2026 we delivered powerful new capabilities for SAP Enterprise Service Management (SAP ESM) customers, partners, and practitioners. Whether you are modernizing HR service delivery, managing financial shared services, or looking to drive higher self-service adoption across the enterprise and every business function, the Q3 2026 release has something for you.

Before we dive in, we’re excited to share our customers’ value stories! Take a moment to register for our upcoming webinars and hear about our customers’ deployment journeys and value achieved from unified, AI-led, shared service operations with SAP ESM.

🚀Tuesday, November 10, 2026

Register here.
 
🚀Thursday, November 19, 2026
Smarter, Faster, Unified: SAP’s Journey to AI-Powered Shared Services
SAP’s global deployment with over 4,000 service professionals live today, serving employees, partners, and customers across 7 business functions.
Register here.

Now, let’s dive into the Q3 2026 innovation highlights including insights on autonomous assistants coming your way!  For even more detailed insights on our Q3 2026 service innovations, register here for the Q3 2026 Release Overview on November 5th, hosted by our product management team.

Intelligent case flow: Less effort with faster resolution

Case management in SAP ESM has proven to deliver the flexibility organizations need to model their shared service processes across the enterprise, coordinating complex workflows between automation and human action. The Q3 2026 enhancements to Case Flow reduce manual steps for both service representatives and administrators, allowing structured service processes to progress more naturally and more efficiently without unnecessary intervention.

Auto Complete Conditions for Input Steps in Case Flow

Input steps within a case flow allow service representatives to capture or update structured data in context without navigating away from the case. Until now, however, marking an input step as complete was always a manual action, even when the required conditions were clearly satisfied.

With this Q3 2026 release, administrators can now define conditions under which an input step will automatically mark itself as complete. When those conditions are met, for example, when specific field values have been set or when a case reaches a particular status, the system evaluates the configured logic and completes the step without requiring a service representative to take action.

Why it matters:

  • High-volume, structured processes benefit most. Think onboarding workflows, procurement inquiries, or HR case handling where multiple input steps follow predictable completion patterns.
  • Service representatives can focus on the steps that genuinely require their judgment, rather than clicking through steps the system can already identify as complete.
  • Administrators retain full control over when auto-completion applies, using the same familiar condition builder available throughout the Case Designer.

Auto Trigger for Case Approval Step

Approval steps in SAP ESM case flows are a critical governance mechanism, ensuring that key decisions are reviewed by the right people before a case proceeds. However, a common source of delay in approval-heavy workflows is simply that service representatives forget, or are too busy, to manually submit the approval request.

This enhancement allows administrators to configure an approval step to auto-submit as soon as its preconditions are met. Once the case reaches the configured state and all entry conditions are satisfied, the approval request is triggered automatically, without service representative intervention.

Why it matters:

  • Eliminates a common bottleneck in approval-gated workflows, particularly in financial shared services and compliance-driven processes where timely approvals are essential.
  • Works alongside existing precondition configuration, giving administrators precise control over when auto-submission is appropriate.
  • Approvers still receive requests and must act. This feature automates the submission, not the decision itself.

Accelerate Financial Service Delivery with Contract Accounts

For organizations delivering financial shared services, whether handling billing inquiries, payment disputes, collection workloads, or contract account management, having complete financial context within the service case is not a nice-to-have; it is essential. The Q3 2026 release introduces a deeply integrated Contract Account View, connecting SAP ESM directly to SAP Cloud ERP FI-CA financial data and bringing it into the agent's hands without the need to switch systems.

Contract Account View: Financial Documents, Invoices, Payments, and Collections

Service representatives working on financial inquiries can now see a complete picture of the customer's financial position right from the ESM agent desktop, without navigating to SAP Cloud ERP transaction screens. These include:

  • Financial Documents and Open Items: All FI-CA transactions for the past 365 days (configurable) are displayed, aggregated by document number.
  • Invoices: The last 12 months of invoices, billing documents, and billing plans are available, each with a direct link to the PDF printout.
  • Payments: All payment documents posted in the last 365 days are visible with real-time, color-coded status tags.
  • Collections: The full collections history from SAP Cloud ERP FI-CA is surfaced directly in ESM, covering dunning records, returns, and write-offs.

Contract Account View: Payment Arrangements, Locks, and Correspondence

Beyond raw financial data, the Contract Account View also provides service representatives with the context needed to understand active agreements, account restrictions, and prior correspondence, all without leaving the service agent desktop.

  • Payment Arrangements: All Promise to Pay agreements and Installment Plans for the contract account are visible in either card or table format.
  • Locks: Active and expired locks applied to the contract account are displayed, including lock type, reason, and date range.
  • Correspondences and Bank Data: Complete correspondence history, key attributes, and bank data, are available in a dedicated tab.

This provides service representatives with a comprehensive financial picture in one place.

Elevating the self-service experience

The self-service application is how employees experience enterprise service management directly. Two Q3 2026 enhancements give administrators more precise control over what employees see and how they interact with their cases, resulting in a cleaner, more focused experience and fewer unnecessary support contacts.

Controlled Case Visibility in List View

In organizations where SAP ESM supports multiple lines of business, not every case type is intended for employee self-service visibility. With this Q3 2026 update, a new attribute has been added to the case type configuration to specify self-service relevance. Only cases belonging to case types that have been marked as self-service relevant in Case Type Configuration will appear in the employee's list. Cases associated with internal, service representative-only, or back-office case types will not be visible in the self-service interface.

Why it matters:

  • Employees see only the cases that are relevant and actionable for them, reducing confusion and erroneous selection.
  • Administrators gain precise control over the self-service experience, aligning what employees see with the organization's service delivery model.
  • This is particularly valuable for organizations running ESM across multiple functions such as HR, Finance, IT, and Procurement, where different case types serve very different audiences.

Enhanced Case Communication History

Understanding the full history of a case, including who said what, when, and through which channel, is fundamental to the self-service experience. Before this release, timeline events and case conversations were combined in a single Conversations tab, which made it harder to quickly locate a particular event or communication.

This enhancement restructures how case history is presented in the self-service interface, making it easier to locate specific events and communications, reducing inquiries back to the service representative and improving resolution times.

Why it matters:

  • A dedicated Timeline tab now presents all case events in chronological order, including status changes, assignments, workflow transitions, and other system-level activities, giving employees a clear audit trail of everything that has happened on their case.
  • The Conversations tab has been refined to focus on actual communications. A new Past Conversations section surfaces all non-internal notes, providing employees with a clear record of the dialogue between them and the service team.
  • Internal notes intended only for service representatives remain hidden from the employee-facing view, ensuring operational transparency is maintained without exposing confidential service team communications.

Preview: Autonomous Assistants

One of the most exciting themes at SAP SAPPHIRE and SAP Connect was the emergence of autonomous, AI-led assistants within SAP ESM. These are not incremental improvements to existing features; they represent a fundamentally different way of working, where Joule Work takes on complex, multi-step service and finance tasks with contextual intelligence and minimal human intervention. We are pleased to share an early look at two assistants currently progressing through Early Adopter Care, with general availability coming soon.

Recurring Receivables Assistant

Managing recurring revenue operations at scale is complex. Collections specialists, invoicing teams, subscription managers, and accounts receivable clerks each work within their own slice of a highly interconnected process, and when an exception occurs, resolving it typically requires manual coordination across multiple systems and stakeholders.

The Recurring Receivables Assistant coordinates execution across subscription orders and contracts, invoices, disputes, payments, and collections. The assistant helps teams prioritize collections, manage subscription contract changes, correct invoices, and resolve customer disputes and payment exceptions across multiple applications and solutions with clearer issue context and faster customer communication.

The assistant supports the core business stages across the receivables lifecycle:

  • Prioritize: Surfaces high-impact accounts, explains risk drivers, and recommends the next-best collection action, so collections specialists focus effort where it matters most.
  • Prevent: Detects invoice rejection risk before downstream impact occurs, identifies likely root causes, and recommends corrections, reducing exceptions before they slow collections.
  • Correct: Identifies contract data issues, validates corrections, simulates billing impact, and guides subscription specialists through the update, unblocking invoice and payment flow.
  • Resolve: Investigates payment exceptions and unmatched payments, connects invoice and contract context, and guides AR clerks through resolution, closing issues with less manual investigation.

Case Management Assistant

Every service representative manages cases, but the experience of working through a complex, multi-step case, coordinating with customers, extracting information from attachments, triggering backend processes, and knowing what to do next, can still be demanding and time-consuming. The Case Management Assistant is designed to change that.

Available as a standalone starting point for a service interaction or embedded directly in the SAP ESM agent desktop, the Case Management Assistant is a Joule-powered AI agent that works alongside service representatives throughout the full case lifecycle. 

Key dimensions of the assistant's capability include:

  • Contextual guidance: The assistant understands where a case is in its workflow and surfaces relevant next steps, so service representatives spend less time figuring out what to do and more time doing it.
  • Document and entity extraction: Attachments, emails, and case descriptions are automatically analyzed to extract key information, reducing manual data entry and improving case accuracy from the outset.
  • Communication assistance: Service representatives receive assistance drafting and refining customer communications within the case, ensuring timely and consistent responses that reflect the service organization's standards.
  • Connected process execution: The assistant can trigger actions in connected SAP systems, such as SAP Cloud ERP, directly from the case context, without requiring service representatives to navigate to separate applications.

Early adopter customers are actively engaged, already reporting measurable reductions in service representative effort. Stay tuned for the general availability announcement, coming soon.

entry.title: Joule Work：实现对话、业务洞察与 Agent 协同的一体化工作空间
entry.content:
即将推出的 Joule Work，把对话交互、业务数据查询、任务进度追踪、异常分析以及 Agent 协同能力整合至动态工作空间内。用户只需用自然语言描述业务目标，系统就会结合业务上下文自动调度所需信息与功能，支撑后续的分析与处理。完成一项工作，无需在多个应用之间来回切换。

从 Conversations 中提出问题，到 Spaces 中集中分析，再到通过 Joule Studio 扩展 AI 能力，Joule Work 将这些体验连接起来，让业务目标与后续行动紧密衔接。

注：Joule Work 暂未正式发布（GA），最终发布范围与上线时间请以 SAP 后续官方公告为准。

图示：Joule Work 将对话、业务工作空间以及开发体验整合在统一界面当中。

产品介绍：Joule Work

 

通过自然语言开启工作：Conversations

Conversations 是和 Joule 交互对话的入口。用户可以描述想要查询的信息或是希望完成的任务，在对话过程中补充筛选条件、持续追问，从而获取对应的指引与结果。对于多步骤的复杂任务，对话也可以作为进入 Spaces 的起点。

举个例子：业务人员想要了解某项任务的进展，可以先抛出问题，再基于返回的结果做进一步分析。这种交互方式让用户直接从业务问题入手，不用事先确定需要打开哪一款应用。

图示：在 Conversations 中查询退货率异常原因、查看仓库各项指标，并将分析结果转入 Space。

 

围绕单一任务集中开展工作：Spaces

Spaces 是围绕特定业务目标搭建的动态工作空间，它会把相关的数据、工具和业务上下文汇聚在同一个环境里，并且根据当前任务动态调整展示内容。适合那些需要持续分析、多项对比或者分多步推进的工作场景，全程保留业务关注点与上下文信息。

以财务关账为例，财务负责人可以从“本月关账遇到了哪些阻碍”这个问题开始，在同一个工作空间查看相关数据、待办事项、异常信息以及 Agent 的活动记录，判断哪些事项需要优先处理，再结合已启用的能力推进后续工作。

图示：Spaces 在工作空间内汇总各个国家、仓库的退货率图表，同时你还可以在右侧继续对话、补充分析。

 

基于业务需求进行扩展开发：Develop / Joule Studio

如果企业团队需要构建专属 AI 能力，可以从 Joule Work 的左侧导航栏进入 Joule Studio。业务人员和开发人员可在 Joule Studio 中搭建适配自身业务流程的 Agents、应用以及自动化流程。

 

Joule Work、Assistant 和 Agent 的协作关系

Joule Work 是用户输入目标、查看信息、推进各项工作的交互界面；Joule Assistants 结合业务角色与流程上下文进行任务统筹；Joule Agents 负责执行专项任务，调用对应的数据、工具以及应用完成工作。

简单来说：用户在 Joule Work 中提出业务目标，由 Assistant 统筹调度所需能力，再由 Agents 执行具体任务，用户查看结果并按需做出决策。企业原有业务系统依旧承担核心业务处理工作。

企业现有的数据权限、业务授权以及审核机制保持不变。Joule Work 只是对接这些能力的交互界面，底层管控能力依托 SAP Business AI Platform；自动化程度需要结合具体业务场景进行配置。

entry.title: What If Joule Could Help You Complete the Business-Driven Configuration Questionnaire? Now It Can.
entry.content:
A successful SAP S/4HANA Cloud implementation starts with understanding how a business works—and translating that understanding into the right configuration. The Business-Driven Configuration Questionnaire (BDCQ), a structured accelerator within the SAP Activate methodology, helps make that connection. Line of Business (LoB) configuration experts use it to gather the configuration values that will ultimately be entered in SAP Central Business Configuration for the customer’s SAP S/4HANA Cloud development system tenants.

More than a questionnaire, the BDCQ is a bridge between SAP consultants and customer business users. It helps ensure that solution configuration reflects real business requirements, both before and during Fit-to-Standard workshops.

Why does the BDCQ matter?

  • It provides early insight into the customer’s business processes and configuration needs.
  • It offers prescriptive guidance on identifying configuration requirements aligned with the implementation scope.
  • It provides a secondary validation of whether SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (Public Cloud) is the right fit for the customer, complementing the Digital Discovery Assessment (DDA).
  • It brings greater structure to the planning and delivery of Fit-to-Standard Analysis workshops.
  • It supports productive conversations between implementation experts and business users during workshops.
  • It connects customer business processes directly to solution configuration activities, including references to specific SSCUI apps or SSCUI groups.

The BDCQ captures two levels of information at different stages of the project:

The value of the BDCQ goes beyond collecting configuration data. It also helps LoB configuration experts build relationships with customer LoB experts and introduces those experts to SAP S/4HANA Cloud early in the project. Ideally, the same customer experts who provide L2 responses will take part in Fit-to-Standard workshops and user acceptance testing before go-live. In this way, the BDCQ also supports the project’s broader change-management effort.

Not every BDCQ maps neatly to a traditional line of business. The implementation team should therefore confirm that all business processes selected in the Digital Discovery Assessment are covered across the available BDCQs. Any remaining processes—for example, Human Resources or Two-Tier ERP—should be assigned based on transferable expertise and team availability.

So, how can AI-assisted support make it easier to complete the BDCQ?

During the Prepare phase, open Perform Initial Business Process Assessment for SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You’ll find the ✦ AI-Assisted Procedure session there.

Open the session and follow the instructions for working with the BDCQ Experts.

For example, the BDCQ-FI Expert can guide you through the questionnaire in a conversational manner. Start the conversation, answer its questions, and review the highlights and key points that deserve attention. This provides structured support as you work through the information required for your BDCQ.

The result is a BDCQ populated with Critical Steps, Scope Items, open items, and potential blockers—as illustrated in the example below.

entry.title: Enrichment of Solution Order Output with Information from Related Transactions Made Possible
entry.content:
Table of Contents

  • Table of Contents
  • Introduction
  • Consider an Example
  • Getting Started
  • How to Set This Up for Solution Order Output?
  • Step 1: Define Your Fields
  • Step 2: Write the Calculation Logic
  • Step 3: Create a Custom Form
  • Step 3: See Your Fields in Action
  • Key Benefits
  • Benefit
  • What It Means
  • What You Can v/s Cannot Do
  • What Works Well
  • Points to Note
  • Best Practices
  • Conclusion

 

Introduction

When you create solution orders and generate output documents like order acknowledgements or invoices, you sometimes need to show information that is not stored in the database. Instead, you want to compute it based on other fields or data from related documents.

For example, you might want to display:

  • Pricing information from follow-on sales orders
  • Data from other business documents linked to the order
  • Information from custom business tables/CDS views
  • Special calculations based on order data

Consider an Example

Imagine a company that sells software solutions. When they create an order acknowledgement, they want to show:

  • The main order information (already in the system)
  • Special pricing discounts based on customer type (calculated field)
  • Expected delivery dates from linked sales orders (calculated field)
  • Processing agents’ contact information (calculated field)

Previously, the only solution was to create permanent custom fields in the database and store the calculated data there. But this wastes database space because you only need this information on the printed output.

Data Source extension and Calculated fields in that solve this problem.

Without this, customers would need to manually create custom database fields.

With data source extension and calculated fields, this information is computed only when printing the order acknowledgement. No database clutter, and your system stays focused on core business data.

 

Getting Started

What is a Data Source Extension?

A Data Source Extension lets you bring additional fields, either from existing data or calculated on the fly, into a user interface or output form, without changing the underlying database structure.

What are Calculated Fields?

They are temporary fields that the system computes on demand when generating an output form. The data is never stored in the database, so you save space and keep your system efficient.

To extend a data source of your solution order output forms, you need:

  • Access to the Custom Fields application in your system
  • Extensibility Expert and Configuration Expert - Business Process Configuration permissions
  • Basic knowledge of ABAP programming (for writing the calculation logic)
  • An existing solution order with output management already configured
  • Adobe LiveCycle Designer

The Process: You create a data source extension, define your fields, implement the calculation logic, define a custom for template, edit the form template to add calculated fields to the print form, upload the modified print form, assign the custom form template to the Solution Order application and test in print preview. Typically, this takes 3-4 hours.

 

How to Set This Up for Solution Order Output?

 Data Source Extensions work through three simple steps:

Step 1: Define Your Fields

Using the Custom Fields application, you create a "Data Source Extension" and define what calculated fields you need and publish. For each field, you specify:

  • Field name (what you'll call it)
  • Field type (text, number, date, currency, etc.)
  • Whether it's for the header or item level

Check: Data Source Extension is created successfully and status is "Published".

Check: The calculated fields are visible in the extension.

Step 2: Write the Calculation Logic

Next, once published you see the system creates a "BAdI Implementation" for your that calculates the field values. Implement the logic to assign a value to the calculated field you created in the previous step.

This program:

  • Receives the solution order data when a form is generated
  • Performs lookups or calculations using that data
  • Fills in the calculated field values
  • Returns the results to the form

Check: Custom Logic implementation has status "Published".

Check: No syntax errors in the BAdI Implementation.

Important: This program can only read data, not modify or save anything.

It's purely a calculation engine.

Step 3: Create a Custom Form

Create a custom form template using the Maintain Form Templates (F1434) application by copying the standard form template. Edit the standard form template using Adobe LiveCycle Designer.

The calculated fields appear in SrvcDocItemExtension entity for item fields and SrvcDocHeaderExtension for header fields in the data view.

Assign the custom form template to the output type BUSINESS_SOLUTION_ORDER

https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_ONPREMISE/8308e6d301d54584a33cd04a9861bc52/a5817657a11a0522e10000000a44147b.html?locale=en-US&state=TEST&version=2022.002

Step 3: See Your Fields in Action

When you generate a print preview or output form for a solution order, the system automatically calculates your custom fields and displays them on the form.

Hint: You can also use Manage Output Items (F2279)” Fiori application to trigger sending output for multiple Solution Orders at once. Additionally, if you want to schedule output for one or more than one Solution Orders based on certain conditions, you could do so using the “Schedule Output for Solution Orders (F9487)” Fiori application (available in 2608 or later).

 

 Key Benefits

 

Benefit

What It Means

Save Database Space

Data is calculated when needed, not stored permanently in the database

Flexible and Powerful

Pull data from other documents, tables, or perform complex calculations

No Database Quota Used

Calculated fields don't count against your system's extension field limits

Output Only

These fields appear only on printed forms i.e. they don't affect other apps or APIs

Easy to Maintain

Changing calculation logic doesn't require database migrations

 

What You Can v/s Cannot Do

What Works Well

  • Display text, numbers, dates, and currency amounts
  • Include information from related documents or tables
  • Perform calculations and lookups
  • Use in print preview and output forms
  • Show data from custom business tables

Points to Note

Read-Only: The calculation program will not modify, create, or save any business data.

Output Only: These fields appear only on printed forms. They don't show up in other apps, reports, or APIs.

No Filtering or Searching: You cannot search or filter orders by calculated field values.

Limited Field Types: Only text and numeric field types are supported. Currency amounts support up to 2 decimal places.

Not for Analytics: Calculated fields cannot be used in analytical queries or reporting views.

 

Best Practices

Performance First: Always design your calculations to work efficiently with large batches of data. The system sends all records to your calculation program at once.

Focus on Display: Use calculated fields only for information that needs to appear on forms. Don't try to use them for filtering, searching, or reporting.

Keep Logic Simple: Complex calculations might slow down form generation. Test your calculations with real data volumes.

Document Your Fields: Clearly name and describe your calculated fields so other team members understand what they contain.

 

Conclusion

Make use of data source extension feature to enhance your solution order output forms without compromising system efficiency. By computing information on-demand, you get flexible, rich documents while keeping your database clean and optimized. Whether you need to display related order information, custom calculations, or data from external sources, calculated fields provide a modern and maintainable solution.

System Information: Available in SAP S/4HANA Cloud 2608 and later.

Related Features: Output Management, Form Data Provider, Data Source Extensions, Custom Fields, Custom Logic, Solution Order.

entry.title: We've concluded our Product Expert Training H2 2026 hybrid flagship event!
entry.content:

Strong feedback from our community

The success of PET H2 2026 is reflected in the feedback from attendees. Across the programme, 94% of attendees were satisfied or very satisfied, and sessions achieved an average rating of 4.4 out of 5.

These results demonstrate the value of providing consistent, high-quality enablement that goes beyond sharing information. By creating opportunities for discussion, collaboration, and direct exchange with experts, PET continues to support partners and colleagues in building the knowledge and confidence needed to deliver successful customer outcomes.

 

Continue learning on demand

The learning doesn't end with the live sessions. Participants can continue to benefit from the expertise shared throughout PET H2 2026 by accessing the session recordings, presentation slide decks, and answered Q&A sheets.

These resources make it easy to revisit key insights, explore product capabilities in more detail, and find answers to questions raised during the sessions, whenever they are needed.
